description: A black power strip sits on the bed in front of you, with a small white USB adapter/dongle connected by a short white cable. The left hand reaches in from the left and the right hand comes in from the right to steady the power strip, then the left hand grips the white USB cable/adapter and pulls it upward and away to remove it from the strip while the right hand keeps the strip from sliding, and both hands release with the cable left lying loose on the bed.
